actions.name: Goring Tusk Thrust
actions.telegraph: The boar lowers its head and paws the ground...
actions.description: The beast charges forward with thick, curving tusks.

actions.name: Muddy Trample
actions.description: Heavy cloven hooves churn the earth beneath you.

actions.name: Snapping Jaws
actions.description: Sharp canine fangs snap toward your limb.

actions.name: Obsidian Talon Rend
actions.telegraph: The stalker rears back, talons spread wide...
actions.description: Razor-black claws slash in a vicious downward arc.

actions.name: Shadow Vapor Breath
actions.description: Choking dark mist billows toward your lungs.

creatures.name: Lord Karas the Undying
creatures.title: Ancient Warlord of the Sunken Crypt

bossPhases.name: Shield of the Tombs
bossPhases.banner: Lord Karas raises an archaic iron crest shield, deflecting incoming blows!

bossPhases.name: Enraged Chthonic Fury
bossPhases.banner: Lord Karas roars with otherworldly rage as dark green spectral flames engulf his greatsword!

actions.name: Crypt Cleaver
actions.telegraph: Lord Karas raises his cleaver high above his crowned skull...
actions.description: The ancient warlord brings down his corroded greatsword with crushing weight.

actions.name: Grave Chill Wave
actions.description: Freezing sepulchral frost radiates outward across the chamber floor.
